messages:
maya-peopleops: @samira-candidate quick ops thread for your APAC virtual interview next Wed. You're in IST and prefer 09:00 IST. We need panel availability, Zoom + dial-in, and accessibility notes.

samira-candidate: Thanks Maya. I'm free 09:00-12:00 IST that day. I need live captions and an India dial-in number (my wifi's intermittent). Also would appreciate a note about extra break time if needed.

sam-patel: 09:00 IST works for me. How long is the interview loop? I can do morning UK time.

jordan-lee: Tentative plan: 60-75m total (30m technical, 30m product, 15m buffer). We'll do a 15m pre-brief for interviewers. Panel: Sam, Jordan, Mei (PM, APAC), Aria (ENG-US). Aria is PST 9:30pm for her.

lisa-office: I can provision a local India dial-in (+91) and set up reimbursement for any candidate connectivity expenses. Suggest a test call the day before to verify captions/dial-in.

maya-peopleops: Good idea. Samira, can you do a 10-min test call Tue 20:00 IST to check captions and dial-in?

samira-candidate: Tue 20:00 IST works. Appreciate it.

jordan-lee: Who's creating the calendar invite? Include: Redwood Zoom link, India dial-in, global dial-ins, 15m prebrief at 08:45 IST, rubric, accessibility note, and fallback plan. Tag me for any changes.

calendar-bot: Created tentative invite: "Candidate Interview 5 Samira (SWE)" 2026-06-10 09:00 IST 9:00-10:15 IST 5 Attendees: sam-patel, jordan-lee, mei-pm, aria-eng, maya-peopleops, samira-candidate. (Status: tentative)

maya-peopleops: I'll flip to confirmed once panel OKs. Adding accessibility line to invite: "Live captions enabled; candidate requested India dial-in; allow extra 10 min buffer."

lisa-office: India dial-in set: +91 22 6123 0000 (PIN 8421). Added backup PST dial-in for Aria. Reimbursement: attach form to invite and cc people-ops.

jordan-lee: Panel please join 15m prebrief at 08:45 IST. Prebrief checklist: 1) reviewer roles, 2) rubric link, 3) accessibility reminders, 4) fallback (recording off; send short take-home if call fails).

sam-patel: Where's the rubric link?

maya-peopleops: Rubric & scoring doc: https://redwood.company/sheets/interview-rubric. Pasted in invite: "Prebrief checklist:
- Roles: Sam=system design, Jordan=product, Mei=infra tradeoffs, Aria=code review
- Scoring 1-4 per section; cite examples
- Accessibility: captions ON; extra buffer; dial-in available
- Fallback: quick pairing kata if connection drops"

sam-patel: All set from my side.

maya-peopleops: Samira, final confirmation email coming later today once Aria confirms PST slot. Also asking about dietary/travel (for records) :)

samira-candidate: No travel/dietary. One more ask: can captions be exported as a transcript and shared after the interview? That helps my notes.

lisa-office: We'll enable live captions and export transcript. We'll include a consent checkbox in the invite about transcript retention per privacy policy.

jordan-lee: Aria confirmed she can join at 21:30 PST which matches 09:00 IST. Marking confirmed on her end.

maya-peopleops: Great. I'll send the final confirmed invite and post it here. :thumbsup:
